long_description:
ABA Building Blocks is a consulting and revenue cycle management company specializing in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy practices. They provide billing services, credentialing support, and practice management consulting specifically tailored to the unique needs of ABA providers.

ABA billing involves complex authorization requirements, session-based coding, and insurance policies that differ significantly from traditional mental health billing. ABA Building Blocks understands these nuances including BCBA supervision requirements, behavior technician billing, and the prior authorization processes specific to autism services.

The company serves ABA therapy practices ranging from solo BCBAs to larger autism service organizations. Their services include insurance verification, claims submission, denial management, credentialing with insurance panels, and consulting on practice operations.

As a specialized ABA billing service, they focus exclusively on the autism and behavioral therapy space rather than general mental health. Practices outside the ABA specialty would benefit from RCM services with broader behavioral health expertise.
best_for: ABA therapy practices needing specialized billing support

ABA practices expanding insurance panel participation
not_for: General mental health or therapy practices
